name: four wires and a blowtorch
did: Search and Destroy rebuilt: three storage tanks per map, a twenty-second defuse that holds you still, wire cutters on the padlock, four randomised wires with a ten-second failsafe, and a blowtorch that welds the tank shut again.
onAccept: The armoury reloads. Your loadouts are kept; anything you had equipped that moved class is still where you left it.
